notes: format: uri checks the generic URI shape only. javascript:alert(1) is a syntactically valid URI, so blocking it is business policy, pinned separately by bq-flow-uri-scheme-policy.

answer_cases.why: Schema-valid; the business MAY still reject the scheme.

wrong_answers.behaviour: treat format: uri as a safe-link guarantee
wrong_answers.why: A platform that renders the answer as a link without its own scheme check is exposed to script URIs.
